Name: Long Hair Sebastian for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Look, I just like guys with long hair, okay? XD

This mod will give Sebastian some long, luscious locks! It's meant to be used with Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], using Poltergeister and IronKelly's open permission assets and creating new ones to replace Ailin8's assets since I couldn't get ahold of them. Simply take the portrait and character sheets from this mod to overwrite! 

Enjoy!
